item.title: GitMorning 0.5.5
item.description:
GitMorning 0.5.5 — Steadier shared lists
- GitMorning keeps using the shared Trending list for up to 8 hours instead of 3, so README excerpts stay visible and fewer requests go to GitHub from your Mac. - Bundled Trending lists refreshed.
공용 목록을 8시간까지 사용해 README 발췌가 더 안정적으로 표시되고 GitHub 직접 요청이 줄어듦
Apple Silicon · macOS 14+. This preview is not Apple-notarized yet; macOS may ask you to approve the first launch.
